title: Document the Video Generation provider type (video pipeline is entirely undocumented)
description: Skill says: architecture.md 'Providers Supported' (lines 164-169) lists text providers and an 'Image gen:' bullet (Pollinations, Stability AI, Together AI, NovelAI, ComfyUI, AUTOMATIC1111) but is silent on video. Reality (2.1): a first-class `video_generation` provider was added to the PROVIDERS map (packages/shared/src/constants/providers.ts:141-149, name 'Video Generation', default base https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta, apiKeyHeader x-goog-api-key) alongside `image_generation` (132-140); both are in the APIProvider enum (packages/shared/src/types/connection.ts:19-20). Unlike text providers, video connections are NOT dispatched through the LLM provider-registry factory (provider-registry.ts has no video/image case) — they are handled by packages/server/src/services/video/video-generation.ts. Fix: add a Video Generation bullet under Providers Supported describing it as a separate connection provider type handled by the video service, not the LLM registry.

title: List the four video generation services and their default model ids
description: Skill says: nothing — architecture.md never names any video service or model. Reality (2.1): a Video Generation connection picks one of five service profiles (VIDEO_DEFAULTS_SERVICES = gemini_omni, google_veo, xai, openrouter, seedance; video-generation-defaults.ts:17-23) exposing four vendor paths: Google AI Studio Gemini Omni (default model gemini-omni-flash-preview), Google AI Studio Veo (veo-3.1-generate-preview), xAI Imagine (grok-imagine-video-1.5), OpenRouter Video (google/veo-3.1, any OpenRouter video model id accepted), and Seedance 2.0 (seedance-2-0). Model defaults at packages/server/src/services/video/video-generation.ts:43-47; described in docs/SCENE_VIDEO_GENERATION.md:14-17. Fix: add a table of the four services + default models to architecture.md's video/providers section.

title: Connection object: note image/video connections are non-LLM provider ids
description: Skill says: architecture.md 'Connection' (lines 53-54) defines a Connection as 'An API configuration pointing at an LLM provider.' Reality (2.1): the APIProvider enum also contains the non-LLM media providers image_generation and video_generation (connection.ts:19-20); a video connection stores per-service defaults in connection.defaultParameters under the 'videoGeneration' key (VIDEO_DEFAULTS_STORAGE_KEY, video-generation-defaults.ts:14) and can be flagged 'Default for Videos' as a chat fallback (docs/SCENE_VIDEO_GENERATION.md:19,43). Fix: broaden the Connection description to cover media (image/video) connections and mention the 'Default for Videos' fallback flag.

title: API Surface omits the scene-video generation endpoints
description: Skill says: architecture.md 'API Surface' (lines 142-162) lists /api/gallery-adjacent and game routes but no video endpoints. Reality (2.1): scene-video generation lives on the gallery routes — POST /api/gallery/generate-scene-video (packages/server/src/routes/gallery.routes.ts:676; it rejects a connection whose provider !== 'video_generation' at :707), GET /api/gallery/scene-videos/:chatId (:641), GET /api/gallery/scene-videos/file/:chatId/:filename (:653) — and Game Mode has parallel /api/game/scene-videos/* endpoints plus a gameVideoConnectionId on setup (game.routes.ts:1080,5421). Fix: add the scene-video endpoints to the API Surface list.

title: API Surface omits /api/conversation-calls and the character-video endpoints
description: Skill says: architecture.md API Surface and Conversation Mode list (lines 80-88) never mention Conversation Calls or their video endpoints. Reality (2.1): a new conversationCallsRoutes is registered at /api/conversation-calls (packages/server/src/routes/index.ts:89), including GET /api/conversation-calls/character-videos/:characterId and POST /api/conversation-calls/character-videos/:characterId/generate (conversation-calls.routes.ts:2253,2264), which require a video_generation connection (:182). Fix: add /api/conversation-calls (with the character-videos generate/list endpoints) to the API Surface.

title: Document Advanced > Video Generation settings and their keys/defaults
description: Skill says: nothing — no skill file mentions video settings. Reality (2.1): 2.1 added Settings > Advanced > Video Generation (CHANGELOG [2.1.0] Added). User settings persist under key 'video-generation' (VIDEO_GENERATION_SETTINGS_KEY, video-generation-settings.ts:7) with defaults sceneVideoDurationSeconds=10, callCustomClipDurationSeconds=5, animatedExpressionClipDurationSeconds=3, and per-kind callClipDurations all 5s (video-generation-settings.ts:15-29); scene duration clamps 1-60s, call clips 1-15s, animated-expression clips 1-8s (:8-13). Fix: add an Advanced Video Generation settings subsection listing these keys, defaults, and clamp ranges.

title: Document per-service video defaults (duration/aspect/resolution) and Veo/Seedance constraints
description: Skill says: nothing. Reality (2.1): each video service carries its own default profile (video-generation-defaults.ts:25-54) — Gemini Omni 10s/16:9 (no resolution; duration is baked into the prompt because Gemini Omni rejects duration_seconds, docs/SCENE_VIDEO_GENERATION.md:21,138-140), Veo 8s/16:9/720p (Veo accepts only 4/6/8s and forces 8s when an image reference is present, :90-96 readVeoDuration + SCENE_VIDEO_GENERATION.md:21), xAI 10s/16:9/720p (1-15s), OpenRouter 10s/16:9/720p, Seedance 5s/16:9/720p with an opt-in temporaryPublicReferenceUploadEnabled + expiry (1h/12h/24h/72h, default 12h) for local first/last-frame references (:48-54,182-184). Fix: add a per-service defaults/constraints table.

title: Document the Animated Expression Engine (portraits via video connections -> looping GIF sprites)
description: Skill says: nothing — architecture.md Roleplay Mode (lines 92-99) mentions VN sprite overlays but not animated expressions. Reality (2.1): the Expression Engine agent (id 'expression', phase post_processing, modeAllowlist roleplay/visual_novel, defaultTools set_expression — packages/shared/src/features/agents/expression/manifest.ts) gained animated portrait generation: it can use a Video Generation connection to create short expression clips, convert them into looping GIF sprites, and save them into expression slots, with Advanced > Video Generation controls for duration (animatedExpressionClipDurationSeconds default 3s) and prompt templates (CHANGELOG [2.1.0] Added). Fix: document the Animated Expression Engine in architecture.md and agents.md.

title: Document first-class scene video generation for Game/Roleplay/VN galleries (Gallery 'Videos', Animate, storyboards)
description: Skill says: architecture.md Game Mode (101-102) and Roleplay Mode (92-99) describe illustrations/backgrounds but no scene video. Reality (2.1): 2.1 added first-class scene video generation for Game Mode, Roleplay, and Visual Novel galleries — Video Generation connections selected per chat under Chat Settings > Agents > Scene Videos, editable game.video prompts, manual Gallery Video actions, per-image Animate buttons, pinnable/draggable video overlays, and Game Mode turn storyboards that animate keyframes (docs/SCENE_VIDEO_GENERATION.md:1-7,36-45,67-81; CHANGELOG [2.1.0] Added). Gallery 'clips' were renamed 'Videos' with separate Images/Videos tabs. Fix: add scene-video features to the Game Mode and Roleplay sections and note the Gallery Images/Videos split.

title: Document per-chat Game Mode media prompt presets (Illustration/Animation/Game Video Prompt selectors)
description: Skill says: nothing about media prompt presets. Reality (2.1): 2.1 added per-chat Game Mode media prompt presets with separate Illustration Prompt, Animation Prompt, and Game Video Prompt selectors, read-only built-ins (Still Keyframes, Comic Page, Colored Manga, B&W Manga, Cinematic Scene Video) plus chat-local editable copies (CHANGELOG [2.1.0] Added; docs/SCENE_VIDEO_GENERATION.md:91-99). The default Game Video Prompt built-in is 'Cinematic Scene Video' (id cinematic-scene-video, packages/shared/src/constants/game-video-prompts.ts:3,31-39). Fix: document the three selectors, the built-in presets, and the chat-local copy model.

title: Document Conversation Call character video presence clips
description: Skill says: architecture.md Conversation Mode (80-88) lists selfies/schedules but no call video. Reality (2.1): when Character Video Presence is enabled, Marinara uses the 'Default for Videos' connection to generate cached avatar-based idle/talking/laughing/angry/crying/sighing clips and plays them in-call from TTS cues, returning to idle after speech; reusable clips live in Character/Persona editor Sprites -> Clips (standard slots + up to 128 named custom clips, plus user-uploaded MP4) and can be requested in-call via [custom_clip] (CHANGELOG [2.1.0] Added; conversation-calls.routes.ts:2253-2281; DEFAULT_CONVERSATION_CALL_VIDEO_CLIP_DURATIONS all 5s, video-generation-settings.ts:15-22). Fix: add Conversation Call character video presence to the Conversation Mode section.

title: Document the video prompt override keys (game.video, renamed from game.omniVideo)
description: Skill says: nothing — architecture.md Prompt Assembly (104-125) does not cover media prompt overrides. Reality (2.1): scene/storyboard video prompts are governed by editable global template keys in Settings > Advanced > Game Prompt Templates and Prompt Overrides: game.video (fallback video template), game.sceneIllustration, game.narrationSummarizer, game.storyboardIllustrationDirector (docs/SCENE_VIDEO_GENERATION.md:101-118). The video template key was renamed from game.omniVideo to game.video in 2.1 (legacy override still read as fallback; CHANGELOG [2.1.0] Fixed). xAI gets a stricter final-prompt budget than Gemini Omni/Veo/OpenRouter. Fix: add these override keys and the game.omniVideo -> game.video rename to the prompt/overrides docs.

title: Document video generation env/config knobs for troubleshooting
description: Skill says: nothing. Reality (2.1): async video jobs are governed by VIDEO_GEN_TIMEOUT_MS (default 1,800,000ms / 30 min; video-generation.ts:41) and per-provider poll intervals GOOGLE_VEO_VIDEO_POLL_INTERVAL_MS (10s), XAI_VIDEO_POLL_INTERVAL_MS (5s), OPENROUTER_VIDEO_POLL_INTERVAL_MS (10s), SEEDANCE_VIDEO_POLL_INTERVAL_MS (10s) (video-generation.ts:61-64). Seedance/other first/last-frame references need public HTTPS URLs via VIDEO_REFERENCE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL or the per-connection temporary-upload toggle; remote video downloads are HTTPS-only and validated as MP4 (docs/SCENE_VIDEO_GENERATION.md:23,120-126,158-160). Fix: add these env vars to the configuration/troubleshooting reference.

title: decision-guide.md is silent on native video generation as a capability
description: Skill says: decision-guide.md walks image generation only via the parallel-agent stack ('Immersive RP character', line 118) and never addresses video. Reality (2.1): scene/portrait/call video generation is now a native capability (a Video Generation connection + Scene Videos / Animated Expression / Call Video Presence, per docs/SCENE_VIDEO_GENERATION.md and CHANGELOG [2.1.0]). Fix: when a user asks 'can characters generate or animate video?', the guide should point to Video Generation connections + the relevant surface (Gallery Animate / storyboards / animated expressions / call presence) rather than implying video is unsupported or requires a webhook.
